WITH d_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk,
           d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
),
cd_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk,
           cd_marital_status,
           cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
),
ca_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ca_address_sk,
           ca_country,
           ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
),
reason_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r_reason_sk,
           r_reason_desc
    FROM reason
)
SELECT substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
       avg(ws.ws_quantity),
       avg(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
       avg(wr.wr_fee)
FROM d_filtered AS d
JOIN web_sales AS ws
  ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns AS wr
  ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
 AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN cd_filtered AS cd1
  ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN cd_filtered AS cd2
  ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
JOIN ca_filtered AS ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN web_page AS wp
  ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN reason_filtered AS r
  ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 1998
  AND (
        (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'D'
            AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
            AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        )
        OR (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'S'
            AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'College'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
            AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        )
        OR (
            cd1.cd_marital_status = 'U'
            AND cd1.cd_marital_status = cd2.cd_marital_status
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
            AND cd1.cd_education_status = cd2.cd_education_status
            AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
        )
    )
  AND (
        (
            ca.ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA')
            AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
        )
        OR (
            ca.ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA')
            AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
        )
        OR (
            ca.ca_country = 'United States'
            AND ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY')
            AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
        )
    )
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
         avg(ws.ws_quantity),
         avg(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
         avg(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
